transcript.text: Hi Ruth, thanks for the opportunity. I'm a cider maker, so I'd be very interested in taking the full harvest. My proposal is to come on Saturday morning from 8:00 to 11:00 and pick all the apples — I estimate about six crates' worth. In exchange, I'd give you 12 sealed one-quart jars of cider from the batch I press. No cash payment, just the cider in trade. I have all my own picking equipment, and I'll make sure every apple is cleared from the tree before your crew arrives in the afternoon.
